verdict.rationale: A state business-filing service could plausibly offer registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for events such as filing status changes, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents any webhook or event-subscription capability. The cited items cover portal profile features, OHID sign-in and tax services, and the probes recorded only robots.txt walls on ohiosos.gov and bsportal.ohiosos.gov.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
